bundle.shortDescription: A custom Minecraft launcher for LiquidBounce
bundle.longDescription: Starts LiquidBounce for Minecraft 1.21.11 with Fabric. The client jar ships with the launcher; Minecraft, the Fabric loader and Java are downloaded from Mojang, Fabric and Adoptium, and mods come from Modrinth.
